sourceChain.answer: latestAnswer reads only chronological turn.steps.at(-1), requires assistant-step.finalNode and hasAssistantReplyContent, and rejects any tool-call in its blocks. No backward fallback to earlier text.
sourceChain.replyContent: Nonblank text, image and opaque other count; reasoning/tool-call do not.
sourceChain.process: ChatNodeSeat uses processSpec answerStep/answerAnchorSeq, processStartSeq, turn closed/live and groupPart. Earlier response may fold only in final-only; reasoning stays process in both all/final.
sourceChain.split: process-groups emits two references to one assistant-step: reasoning joins process; response stands outside step run. Original block order and one interruption marker are retained.
sourceChain.settlement: ClientAssistantStream stages exact durable settlement until end; successful message retains transient rows until owning step/end; interrupted/failed/abandoned retire immediately. Stable assistant-step key survives transitions.
sourceChain.alwaysOpen: Original turnProcessAlwaysOpen keeps open turns and aborted/interrupted/error turns open; interleaved input also keeps process open. Final-only membership applies only when folding is eligible.
